rationale: The report describes a native Rust panic (SIGABRT/abort in a Tokio worker) in uv itself when uvx is spawned with piped stdio and no PTY. A panic is a defect in uv, not expected behaviour, so bug. The repro steps are simple (spawn uvx with piped stdin/stdout, pty: false) and need no private index or special machine, so a maintainer can attempt it without asking. Gap: the crash excerpt omits the panic message and uv frames, so the failing code path is not yet identified; a maintainer would likely want the stderr panic line and RUST_BACKTRACE output. Search for the symptom and for a non-TTY/stdin panic found no earlier issues. The docs search had no page describing TTY-less behaviour as a guarantee, and nothing points to an external cause.
